process.title: From “where do I start?” to “taken care of.”

steps.text: Choose a service, book an office visit, or start remotely. We'll define the scope and confirm the fee.

faq.title: A little clarity, before you start.

personal-tax.name: Personal tax
personal-tax.intro: From your first return to retirement, get personal tax help that sees the whole picture. In person in Vancouver and Burnaby, or remotely across Canada.

image.alt: An accountant reviewing tax documents with a couple in a bright office

scope.title: A return that reflects your real life.
scope.text: A new job. A first home. A growing family. We help you understand what to bring and what happens next.

items.title: Income, brought together
items.text: Employment, pensions, investments, rental income, and self-employment in one coordinated return.

items.title: Credits worth a closer look
items.text: A review of the deductions and credits relevant to your circumstances, including tuition, medical expenses, donations, and RRSP contributions.

items.title: Changes handled thoughtfully
items.text: Support with prior-year returns, adjustments, moving, retirement, and changes in family circumstances.

docs: Photo identification and prior-year notice of assessment
Employment, pension, investment, and other income slips
RRSP receipts and relevant deduction receipts
Rental or self-employment records, if applicable
Details of changes in address, residency, or family status

faqs.question: Can I file without visiting an office?
faqs.answer: Yes. Start through the existing remote filing page, or contact us to discuss the best way to share your documents.

faqs.question: Can you help with more than one tax year?
faqs.answer: Tell us which years you need prepared. We will review the scope and confirm the records required and fees before proceeding.

faqs.question: How much will my return cost?
faqs.answer: Your fee depends on the income sources and work involved. Contact us for a quote tailored to your situation.

corporate-tax.name: Corporate tax
corporate-tax.intro: Corporate tax preparation and year-end support for Canadian business owners. Connect your records, your corporate return, and your next business decision.

image.alt: Business owners reviewing a financial report with an accountant

scope.title: A more connected year end.
scope.text: Bookkeeping, business tax, and your personal return belong in the same conversation. Start with where your business is today.

items.title: Corporate returns
items.text: T2 return preparation and a review of the supporting financial information and schedules required for your corporation.

items.title: Owner-manager coordination
items.text: Review salary and dividend considerations alongside your corporate and personal tax needs.

items.title: Year-end readiness
items.text: Identify missing records, reconcile key balances, and coordinate bookkeeping, GST/HST, and payroll needs.

docs: Prior corporate tax return and notice of assessment
Year-end trial balance, general ledger, and financial statements
Bank, credit card, loan, and investment statements
Asset purchases, disposals, and financing details
Shareholder, payroll, dividend, and GST/HST records

faqs.question: Is this different from filing as a sole proprietor?
faqs.answer: Yes. A corporation files a corporate return. Sole-proprietor income is generally addressed through a personal return. Tell us how your business is structured so we can direct you.

faqs.question: Can you help if my books are behind?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can discuss catch-up bookkeeping and the work needed to prepare your records for the corporate return.

faqs.question: Can you coordinate my personal and corporate tax?
faqs.answer: We can review both engagements together so owner compensation and supporting records are considered consistently.
